## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/ragflow/chat/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['parse a RAGFlow model name in format ragflow/chat/{chat_id}/{model} or ragflow/agent/{agent_id}/{model} into endpoint type, entity id, and model name', 'build the complete RAGFlow API URL from api_base, model name, and endpoint type for chat or agent completions', 'validate environment and set up Authorization and Content-Type headers for RAGFlow API requests', 'transform request by extracting the actual model name from RAGFlow format and delegating to OpenAI-compatible request transformer', 'get OpenAI-compatible provider info including api_base, api_key, and custom provider from RAGFlow model name']
```

